title: addon.forge.json
description: Machine-readable record of the Phase 1 interview (docs/SPEC.md §6.5). Used by `forge new`, `smoke`, `list` and CI.

name.description: Folder name under addons/: lowercase kebab-case.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in Stremio. Defaults to the name in Title Case.

id.description: Manifest id, dot-separated reverse domain. Defaults to community.addonforge.<name>.

types.description: Content types: movie, series, channel, tv, or a custom type.

idScheme.description: imdb: reuse IMDb ids (tt…, metadata from Cinemeta). custom: own prefix, needs an own meta handler.

idPrefix.description: Prefix of the add-on's own ids when idScheme is custom, e.g. "myaddon:".

terms.description: Link to the source's terms of use.

catalogFeatures.description: search: Stremio's search bar also queries the catalog. searchOnly: the catalog only answers searches (no row on the Board). genre: a genre filter on Discover. pagination: more than 100 items, loaded page by page.

genres.description: Genre options offered in Stremio when catalogFeatures includes genre.

userConfig.description: Values each user provides, mapped to manifest.config. See https://github.com/Stremio/stremio-addon-sdk/blob/master/docs/api/responses/manifest.md#user-data

hosting.description: localhost: same computer. lan: other devices at home (needs an HTTPS tunnel). internet: always-on public host.

port.description: Port the add-on listens on, on 127.0.0.1. Defaults to 7100 (7000 is taken by AirPlay on macOS).

contentPolicyAcknowledged.description: The user confirmed the content policy. Must be true when stream is a resource.
